Actually reverse: remove bromine to get benzene (hydrogen). So template likely is aromatic halogenation (bromination) forward; retrosynthetic template would break C-Br bond and form C-H. So we need to search templates where functional_groups_broken includes halide? Wait forward reaction forms halide, breaks hydrogen (C-H). So in forward: functional_groups_formed: halide; functional_groups_broken: hydrogen? Not in list. Maybe we can search with functional_groups_formed: halide and functional_groups_broken: aromatic hydrogen? Not available. Could search with bonds_broken: "6-6"? Not sure.

The C-Br bond formed is 6-6? Actually aromatic carbon (sp2) to halogen (Br) is a single bond between carbon (atomic number 6) and bromine (35). So bond type "6-35". Not sure.
